claims.verbatim:
Steamship America (Brem), Meyer, Bremen July 1, via
Southampton 4th, 3 PM, with mdse and 648 passengers, to
Oelrichs & Co. Had westerly winds the whole passage.
4th inst, off Portland, passed steamship Borussia, hence for
Hamburg; 5th, lat 49 49, lon 8 50, steamship Teutonia, from
Hamburg for New York.

bound E.
